info.name: Module Platform API
info.description: Local dev collection. Run Login requests first (they save tokens). Gateway :5100 unless noted.

body.raw:
{
  "manifestYaml": "# manifest.yml — Module registration contract (v1). All keys required unless marked optional.
manifestVersion: "1.0"

module:
  name: loyalty
  displayName: Loyalty Program
  description: Points, tiers and rewards for tenant members.
  version: 1.0.0
  owner: loyalty-team@company.com
  license: proprietary
  icon: loyalty
  category: engagement

dependencies: []

service:
  healthCheck: /healthz
  readinessCheck: /readyz
  openapiUrl: /swagger/v1/swagger.json

frontend:
  remoteUrl: http://localhost:5174/loyalty/1.0.0/remoteEntry.js
  scope: loyalty_remote
  modulePrefix: /loyalty
  routes:
    - path: /loyalty/members
      exposes: ./MembersPage
      requiredPermission: LOYALTY_MEMBER_VIEW
      menuId: loyalty.members
  menus:
    - id: loyalty
      parentId: null
      title: Loyalty
      icon: star
      route: /loyalty
      requiredPermission: null
      order: 20
    - id: loyalty.members
      parentId: loyalty
      title: Members
      icon: users
      route: /loyalty/members
      requiredPermission: LOYALTY_MEMBER_VIEW
      order: 1
  uiPermissions: [LOYALTY_MEMBER_VIEW, LOYALTY_MEMBER_UPDATE]

api:
  routes:
    - upstream: /api/v1/loyalty/members/{rest}
      downstream: /api/v1/members/{rest}
      methods: [GET, POST]
      auth: true
      requiredPermission: LOYALTY_MEMBER_VIEW
      priority: 10
  seed:
    roles:
      - name: Loyalty Operator
        description: Runs loyalty day-to-day
        isSystem: true
    permissions:
      - code: LOYALTY_MEMBER_VIEW
        object: LOYALTY_MEMBER
        action: VIEW
        name: View loyalty members
        isMenuAccess: true
      - code: LOYALTY_MEMBER_UPDATE
        object: LOYALTY_MEMBER
        action: UPDATE
        name: Update loyalty members
        isMenuAccess: false
    menus: []
    userRoles:
      - userEmail: ops@example.com
        roleName: Loyalty Operator
    rolePermissions:
      - roleName: Loyalty Operator
        permissions: [LOYALTY_MEMBER_VIEW, LOYALTY_MEMBER_UPDATE]
    userAdditionalPermissions:
      - userEmail: auditor@example.com
        permissions: [LOYALTY_MEMBER_VIEW]
    users:
      - email: ops@example.com
        name: Loyalty Operator
    gatewayRules: []

upgrade:
  notes: "1.0.0 initial seed; no data migration."
  migrateEndpoint: /internal/migrate
",
  "artifactApiUrl": "http://localhost:5201",
  "artifactRemoteUrl": "http://localhost:5174/loyalty/1.0.0/remoteEntry.js"
}
